nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: ADR-055 Block 5.2 — image MCP tool handler (the intermediate between the n8n MCP Server Trigger's generate_image tool and the shared Image Tool Handler (v1)). Inputs come from the toolWorkflow node's $fromAI mapping in 'Haxe Image MCP (v1)': prompt (string), reference_file_ids_json (JSON-array string of input-image file_ids), count (number), aspect_ratio (string), size (string), clickup_task_id (string — the triggering task id the agent copies from its message, for cost attribution; ADR-057 follow-up). This handler resolves reference_file_ids -> signed URLs via the agent_input_file_map table (NO session context — Block 5.1), then delegates to Image Tool Handler (v1) UNCHANGED so the image-gen+upload+cost-logging core is shared (one path, ADR-055). Returns {status, file_ids[], message, count_*, warnings[]} to the harness. NB the harness calls this directly, so this workflow FIRES its own Post Alert (no Stage B caller to fire the returned warnings).

nodes.name: Parse Tool Input
nodes.notes: Normalize the tool args into the Image Tool Handler tool_input contract. reference_file_ids_json -> array of file_id strings (ref_ids); tool_input_json = {prompt, reference_file_ids, count, aspect_ratio?, size?}. count defaults 1 (Image Tool Handler clamps 1..4). Always emits exactly 1 item.

nodes.name: Resolve References
nodes.notes: Resolve the requested reference_file_ids -> their original signed URLs via agent_input_file_map (ADR-055 §4; written by Upload Input Images (v1)). Returns 0..N rows {file_id,url,mime,source_ref}. alwaysOutputData so the common no-refs / not-found case still emits an item and the chain runs. onError=continueRegularOutput + retry so a DB hiccup degrades fail-soft (generate without references + WARN) instead of throwing into the harness. Reference NOT-found warnings are emitted downstream by Image Tool Handler itself (it gets only the resolved rows as its file_map).

parameters.query: select file_id, url, mime, source_ref from public.agent_input_file_map where file_id in (select jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb));

nodes.name: Build Handler Inputs
nodes.notes: Build the Image Tool Handler (v1) call inputs: file_map_json = the resolved rows (the unresolved ids stay in tool_input_json so Image Tool Handler emits its own reference-not-found WARN — reuse, no duplicate logic). triggered_by='image_mcp' (migration 036; the MCP path has no real trigger context). impact='Średni' (the lane __default__ tier; '__default__' itself is INVALID for agent_runs.impact_check, and the harness passes no task impact, so MCP image gens are tier-fixed to 'Średni'). clickup_task_id = the agent-copied task id from Parse Tool Input (ADR-057 follow-up): the n8n MCP Server Trigger exposes no inbound headers/body to the handler (Block 5.1), so the agent-supplied tool arg is the only task-attribution channel. When present it lands on the per-image agent_runs row -> included in Write Cost Field (v1)'s per-task SUM. When empty (model omitted it) it falls back to a NULL task id (un-attributed, the old behaviour) AND fires a WARN so the degradation is visible. A DB lookup error -> a pre_warning (fail-soft). Single item.

nodes.name: Call Image Tool Handler
nodes.notes: Delegate to Image Tool Handler (v1) (vpGswBj2kR2D85hl) UNCHANGED — the shared image-gen core (build requests -> Generate Images Parallel (v1) -> Files-API upload -> aggregate), which writes the per-image agent_runs cost rows via the batch's own Log Model Run (no second cost writer). Returns {status, file_ids[], images[], message, warnings[], count_*}. It is fail-soft/branch-free and never throws; onError=continueErrorOutput is a belt-and-braces guard routing a hard executeWorkflow failure to Build Handler Failed.

nodes.name: Build MCP Output
nodes.notes: Shape the MCP tool result the harness/agent reads: {status, file_ids[], message, count_*, warnings[]}. Drops images[].b64_json (the agent only needs file_ids; produced-image bytes for ClickUp delivery are a Block-6 concern — and Files-API uploads are NOT downloadable, so Block 6 needs a separate carrier; flagged). Merges this handler's pre_warnings (DB lookup) with Image Tool Handler's warnings.

nodes.name: Build Handler Failed
nodes.notes: Defensive: Image Tool Handler (v1) threw (executeWorkflow error output). It is designed never to throw, so this is rare; returns a failed tool result + a CRITICAL warning so the harness gets a clean answer and the channel is alerted.

nodes.name: Merge Final
nodes.notes: Converge the normal output (Build MCP Output, 0) and the defensive handler-threw output (1) into the ONE canonical result. Final Return re-reads this node so the alert side-trip can't corrupt the return (return-determinism idiom).

nodes.name: Classify Alert
nodes.notes: One consolidated alert decision: any CRITICAL warning -> CRITICAL; else any warnings -> WARN; else none. The harness calls this endpoint directly, so warnings MUST be fired here (no Stage B caller).

nodes.name: Should Alert?
nodes.notes: TRUE -> Post Alert (one consolidated WARN/CRITICAL). FALSE -> Merge Tail. Both rejoin at Merge Tail -> Final Return (single terminal).

nodes.name: Post Alert
nodes.notes: Centralized Post Alert (v1) seam (ADR-025, YSCdHlmdf3p9XEUx) — never post to ClickUp directly. onError=continueRegularOutput so an alert-channel hiccup never breaks the tool return. No loop risk: trigger is executeWorkflow/MCP, not a webhook watching the Alerts task.

nodes.name: Merge Tail
nodes.notes: Rejoin the alerted (0) and not-alerted (1) paths into the single terminal input. Append; exactly one executes.

nodes.name: Final Return
nodes.notes: SOLE TERMINAL. Re-reads the canonical result from Merge Final (NOT its direct input, which Post Alert would have replaced) — return-determinism idiom (CLAUDE.md). Returns {status, file_ids[], message, count_*, warnings[]} to the toolWorkflow node -> the MCP tool result.
